MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "J-B Weld felt useful because it supports durable repairs, much like my previous purchases of repair tape, vinyl cement, and clamps.",
    "Industrial-strength VELCRO felt like a useful addition because removable fastening serves a different purpose from the permanent adhesives and tape I already use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The washers and locking nuts require particular sizes and applications; buying clamps and connectors does not mean I currently need those specific parts.",
    "The caliper and temperature guns could help with troubleshooting, but I would need a specific measurement task before choosing them.",
    "Twelve large tubes of sealant exceed my current needs, and the wall-decorating assortment does not fit the repair work suggested by my history."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in repair supplies seemed to be taken as interest in almost any workshop tool or hardware assortment.",
    "My inspection-camera purchase seemed to imply a broader need for diagnostic equipment than I actually have."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I choose supplies when their function fits a concrete job; exact dimensions and quantities matter as much as a general connection to repairs.",
    "Gorilla epoxy felt relevant and familiar, but after choosing J-B Weld I would skip another epoxy for the same immediate need.",
    "My past bulk purchases do not mean every supply is useful in bulk; the amount has to suit how I expect to use that particular product."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but stretched them into tools, specific hardware, and quantities I have no current reason to buy."
}
